title: AttestArc OKF concept file (on-disk shape)
description: The ON-DISK shape of a single verified-knowledge concept in AttestArc's Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.2) bundle under knowledge/bootstrap/**. A concept file is a UTF-8 markdown file: a YAML frontmatter block (this schema describes the frontmatter mapping) delimited by '---', followed by the markdown BODY, which carries the claim prose. AttestArc's authoritative content lives under the 'attestarc' namespace; the OKF-native 'type' selects the concept type; the markdown body is the claim. All OTHER OKF-native frontmatter keys (title, tags, sources, status, stale_after, generated, verified) are a DERIVED, ADVISORY projection for generic OKF consumers: no AttestArc code path reads them and they are EXCLUDED from the canonical entry digest, so they can be regenerated freely. Trust is NEVER decided from an OKF-native field — the sole authoritative trust gate is the Sigstore/OIDC attestation over manifest.json (see THREAT_MODEL.md). scripts/okf.py serializes/parses this file with a deterministic stdlib-only subset (no multi-line scalars, always-quoted strings, sorted keys); scripts/knowledge.py reconstructs the internal entry dict (schemas/knowledge.schema.json) from it via entry_from_concept, reading ONLY 'type', the body, and the 'attestarc' namespace.

type.description: OKF-native concept type. Carries the authoritative entry 'kind' (entry_from_concept maps type -> kind). MUST be non-empty for OKF conformance; an empty/absent type is a snapshot-conformance violation (validate_snapshot).

attestarc.description: The AUTHORITATIVE AttestArc namespace: every field the security code reads. entry_from_concept lifts these to the top level of the reconstructed internal entry dict (schemas/knowledge.schema.json). 'kind' and 'claim' are intentionally absent here — 'kind' is the OKF-native 'type' and 'claim' is the markdown body.

status.description: AUTHORITATIVE lifecycle status (5-value). The advisory OKF-native 'status' is a lossy 3-value projection of this and is never read by code.

items.description: AUTHORITATIVE provenance record. 'authority' (a score) deliberately lives here, NOT as an OKF-native source key (OKF avoids scores), so validate_snapshot's provenance-mismatch guard keeps working. The OKF-native sources[] projection carries only 'resource' (=url) and 'author' (=publisher).

title.description: ADVISORY OKF-native projection (= attestarc.subject). Never read by AttestArc code; excluded from the entry digest.

tags.description: ADVISORY OKF-native projection (= [platform, subject]). Never read by code.

sources.description: ADVISORY OKF-native provenance projection. Each item carries only 'resource' (= attestarc.sources[].url) and 'author' (= attestarc.sources[].publisher). The authoritative provenance (with type/authority/retrieved_at) is under attestarc.sources. Never read by code.

status.description: ADVISORY OKF-native lifecycle (3-value, lossy projection of attestarc.status). Never read by code; a trust decision NEVER rests on it.

stale_after.description: ADVISORY OKF-native freshness hint (= attestarc.expires at 00:00:00Z). Never read by code — freshness is enforced by the attested manifest expiry, not this field.
